From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-discovery: technical deep dive — proposed 75m & preflight checklist

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the call today — great conversation and clear alignment on where Edgeware wants to take model-serving latency/cost in the next quarter. As discussed, next step is a technical deep dive with our ML + infra folks to validate performance targets and walk through an ops runbook.

High-level proposal:
- Duration: 75 minutes (we find 60–90m best for an Ops + ML walkthrough)
- Goal: reproduce a representative inference run, review routing/fallbacks, and agree on roll-out requirements
- Attendees we suggest: your ML lead, infra lead, and 1 product/PO; our demo lead (Ben), infra runbook owner (Monica), and me to coordinate

Preflight asks (short):
1) Confirm preferred slot from the options below (all PT):
   - Tue Nov 24, 9:00–10:15
   - Wed Nov 25, 11:00–12:15
   - Thu Nov 26, 8:00–9:15
2) Confirm the model variant you want us to demo (e.g., redwood-llama-70b-q4 or a 13B variant)
3) Provide a contact for SOC2/evidence requests (if we need to show config / retention controls during the call)
4) If you want us to run against a small sample of your data, please share an anonymized sample (S3 link or a CSV) or confirm we can use our synthetic dataset
5) Environment access: will you provide temporary API credentials or prefer us to run a local benchmark in your VPC?

I've attached a short mutual_action_plan.pdf and a draft tdx-agenda.md that lays out timeboxing and roles.

If you confirm a slot I'll send a calendar invite with a pre-call (15m) for our internal run-through 30 minutes prior.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Director, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.pdf, tdx-agenda.md

Ben/Monica —

Liam confirmed Nov 24, 9:00–10:15 PT. I'm marking the slot tentatively; I'll send the invite once you confirm internal availability for a 8:45–9:00 brief. Quick tasks so we come in aligned:

Ben (demo lead):
- Prepare a 10–12 minute perf run showing redwood-llama-70b-q4 vs a 13B baseline (cost + 95th pct latency). Attach a tiny slide with token counts and batching settings.
- Bring a live endpoint we can flip between model variants (hot-switch) and a short script to simulate KV-cache warmup.

Monica (runbook / infra owner):
- Draft a short ops checklist for the call: keys to collect (API vs VPC), network checks, fallback policy we'll demo, and a short rollback play. Put that in access-instructions.txt
- Prep a test harness we can run if they prefer local network benchmarking (ssh tunnel + sanitized sample).

Other notes:
- If they provide the S3 CSV, we'll test with an identical preprocessing step. If not, we use our synthetic sample and call out delta expectations.
- Ask: do we want to run any quantized execution (int8/q4) during the live demo? If so, note memory/latency tradeoffs on the slide.

I'll draft the calendar invite and attach mutual_action_plan.pdf + tdx-agenda.md. Can you both ACK by EOD?

Thanks —
Priya
